name: CSV Export Button on Inventory Page
description: Add a CSV export button to the inventory page that exports filtered inventory items

subtasks.title: Add export button to card header
Verify CSV contains all inventory columns

acceptanceCriteria: CSV export button visible in the inventory page card header
CSV file contains all inventory columns (SKU, Item Name, Category, Quantity, Reorder Point, Unit Cost, Total Value, Location, Status)
CSV includes only filtered items visible in the table
Exported filename includes timestamp for easy identification
CSV is properly formatted with headers and escaped values
